## Product and deployment work

### Continued source pull request #100

Pull request #100 adds only two files under `public/sources/japanese-web-fiction-platforms-starter/`: `README.txt` and `search_index.yml`. It introduces three first-party Japanese web-fiction discovery destinations — 小説を読もう！ / 小説家になろう, カクヨム, and エブリスタ — at link-only compatibility. No origin work text, chapter list, ranking data, comments, covers, author profiles, account data, or paid content is copied or fetched by WebNR.

Fresh first-party review reconfirmed the admission boundary before merge. 小説家になろう's current terms explicitly prohibit automated access/data collection except through the official Narō Developer APIs; カクヨム's current terms reserve service intellectual property and prohibit use of obtained data outside the allowed private-use scope without permission; エブリスタ's current member terms reserve service-content rights and prohibit unlicensed reproduction, transmission, translation, adaptation, and other reuse. Their current public discovery/search surfaces were reachable. The source therefore remains link-only, with any richer adapter requiring a separate machine-interface, robots, cadence, paging, timeout, provenance, update/deletion, attribution, and work-rights audit backed by fixtures.

Pull request #100 final head `b6f4951232813c164d5327283753be8bcc1b35a5` completed Quality run `32277199517`. Web quality, Production evidence, and Documentation quality succeeded on the first attempt. Chromium user journeys were initially cancelled while installing Chromium before the production build or browser tests began; the individual job was rerun without weakening the gate, and the retry completed successfully through the application build and browser journeys. The workflow's final conclusion is success with all four expected jobs successful.

A fresh from-scratch review after green CI re-read the repository operating contract, compared the exact base `9f84e2fbbc9b801aab86b083db73df53dba523ab` to the final head, inspected the two-file complete diff, verified the current first-party rights/access evidence, confirmed no review comments or unresolved review threads, and found no scope drift or regression requiring correction. ## Source growth program

### New candidates discovered today

Five previously untracked Japanese discovery candidates were added to today's source ledger: 小説を読もう！ / 小説家になろう, カクヨム, エブリスタ, ハーメルン, and Nolaノベル. This meets the daily minimum of five newly discovered source or collection candidates.

### Full audits

**小説を読もう！ / 小説家になろう — PASS for link-only discovery; richer automation only through an explicitly permitted interface.** The official public reader/search surface is live. Current group terms prohibit automated access or data collection except through Narō Developer APIs, and the group publishes a separate developer service for supported machine access. The admitted WebNR entry stores only the official destination and WebNR-authored metadata. Because WebNR performs no origin request for this starter, origin CORS, cookies, login state, pagination, response size, request cadence, timeout, and encoding are outside the admitted runtime boundary. Any richer integration must use a permitted official interface and add reproducible capability/rights fixtures before admission.

**カクヨム — PASS for link-only discovery; richer adapter deferred.** KADOKAWA's current public search/explore surface is live. The current service terms reserve service intellectual property, preserve member copyright in submitted content under the stated service license, and prohibit use of obtained data outside the allowed private-use scope without permission. WebNR therefore stores only a first-party landing URL and its own description/labels. No search-result polling, ranking ingestion, chapter retrieval, account automation, or paid-content access is admitted. Richer compatibility remains deferred until an explicitly permitted machine interface plus robots, cadence, pagination, timeout, provenance, update/deletion, and work-rights behavior can be tested.

**エブリスタ — PASS for link-only discovery; richer adapter deferred.** The official novel-list and ranking surfaces are live. The current member terms state that rights in service content belong to the company or third parties except as expressly licensed and prohibit unlicensed reproduction, transmission, transfer, lending, translation, adaptation, and other reuse; member-authored content copyright remains with the member subject to the platform's stated service license. The WebNR entry therefore opens the official discovery surface only and copies no work or platform catalog content. Any richer adapter requires a separate interface/robots/cadence/paging/timeout/provenance/update/deletion/work-rights audit and fixtures.
